Phenotype definition: Fecal 16S rRNA–based taxonomic abundance; genus Veillonella and family Veillonellaceae
Phenotype processing: Cohort-level abundance filtering and log transformation; zero-abundance observations excluded; cohort-specific adjusted abundance phenotypes meta-analyzed
Association model / scale: mbQTL abundance analysis; source-specific transformed abundance scale
Covariate adjustment: Age, sex, genetic principal components (3 for monoethnic cohorts or 10 for multiethnic/admixed cohorts), plus available technical microbiome covariates such as stool storage/delivery time and sequencing batch
MR interpretation: Core microbiome exposure source. Treat beta as a source-specific transformed microbial-abundance effect, not as an absolute abundance unit

Phenotype definition: Binary gastric cancer endpoint in European ancestry; intra-European meta-analysis of harmonized UK Biobank and FinnGen disease GWASs
Phenotype processing: Harmonized UK Biobank and FinnGen disease phenotypes; cohort summary statistics combined by inverse-variance meta-analysis
Association model / scale: Binary disease GWAS; logistic mixed-model framework; log-odds scale
Covariate adjustment: UK Biobank SAIGE disease GWAS used age, age², sex, age×sex, age²×sex and top 20 genetic PCs; FinnGen used its release-specific disease-GWAS adjustment before meta-analysis
MR interpretation: Primary gastric cancer outcome; 1,029 cases / 475,087 controls

Phenotype definition: C3_STOMACH: malignant neoplasm of stomach; registry/ICD-based binary endpoint; controls are non-cases
Phenotype processing: Registry-derived stomach cancer case definition (including ICD-10 C16 and corresponding historical/cancer-registry codes); FinnGen QC/imputation pipeline
Association model / scale: SAIGE binary disease GWAS; log-odds scale
Covariate adjustment: Age, sex, genotyping batch and first 10 genetic principal components in the standard FinnGen GWAS framework
MR interpretation: Alternative European outcome sensitivity analysis; not an independent replication because FinnGen contributes to GCST90018849

Phenotype definition: Binary gastric cancer endpoint in East Asian ancestry, corresponding to the harmonized BioBank Japan gastric cancer phenotype
Phenotype processing: BioBank Japan disease-GWAS framework; harmonized for cross-population comparison
Association model / scale: SAIGE binary disease GWAS; log-odds scale
Covariate adjustment: Age, age², sex, age×sex, age²×sex and top 20 genetic principal components
MR interpretation: Cross-ancestry outcome sensitivity analysis; 7,921 cases / 159,201 controls

Phenotype definition: Higher-taxon relative abundance derived by summing species-level shotgun-metagenomic relative abundances
Phenotype processing: Higher taxa with >50% prevalence: rank-based inverse-normal transformed continuous abundance; 5–50% prevalence: presence/absence
Association model / scale: REGENIE; linear regression for transformed abundance and logistic regression for presence/absence; fixed-effect meta-analysis
Covariate adjustment: Sex, age, age², metagenomic plate and genetic PCs 1–10
MR interpretation: Primary Post-reg exposure-source robustness source. Exposure scale differs from MiBioGen and DMP, so cross-GWAS MR estimates are compared side-by-side rather than formally pooled

Phenotype definition: Shotgun-metagenomic taxonomic relative abundance in 7,738 European participants
Phenotype processing: Relative abundance natural-log transformed; zero values treated as missing; SAIGE inverse-rank normalization before association testing
Association model / scale: SAIGE v0.38 linear mixed model; inverse-rank-normalized abundance scale
Covariate adjustment: Age, sex and the genetic relationship matrix among participants
MR interpretation: Secondary Post-reg exposure-source robustness source. Not completely independent from MiBioGen because limited Lifelines-related overlap was documented
